RPG Maker MV has the Dark Fantasy Character Pack DLC, and it includes not only tall versions of those characters but the MV actors and People, too. Since the heads are the same size as the chibi sprites, you can actually do a lot with head swaps and recoloring. I don't know if there is anything native to MZ that is similar.
